description: This file defines an API client for a frontend application, using axios to communicate with a backend server. It includes configuration for authorization headers, and exposes helper methods for authentication, email management, and labels.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning token/user data.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided payload, returning token/user data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists emails in a mailbox with pagination and filters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a single email by ID, including body and attachments.

methods.name: updateFlags
methods.description: Updates flags (read, starred, archived, deleted) for a specific email.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Sends an email with specified fields.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description: Uploads files as attachments for a specific email or draft.
